title: Can't Set Image as Wallpaper by Dragging and Dropping to Desktop in a Wayland Session
line: Dropping an image from a web browser onto the desktop and choosing Set Image now makes it the wallpaper.
explanation: When an image is dragged from a browser, the drop menu passes its http(s) URL to the image wallpaper. ImageBackend::addUsersWallpaper hands it to ImageProxyModel::addBackground, which silently rejects anything that isn't a local file, so Set Image did nothing. The backend now downloads remote URLs with KIO into ~/.local/share/wallpapers (adding an image suffix if the name lacks one and picking a free name on clashes), adds the local copy and emits a signal; the desktop wallpaper then saves it as its Image, like a local drop.

commits.message:
wallpapers/image: download remote images dropped on the desktop

Choosing "Set Image" after dropping an image from a web browser did
nothing, because the image wallpaper only accepted local files. Remote
images are now downloaded into the user's wallpapers folder and set.

BUG: 480557
